dog.definition: A domesticated animal commonly kept as a companion.
dog.exampleUsage: The dog waits beside its owner.

cat.definition: A small domesticated animal commonly kept as a companion.
cat.exampleUsage: The cat rests in its carrier.

hamster.definition: A small rodent with cheek pouches, sometimes kept as a pet.
hamster.exampleUsage: The hamster carries food in its cheek pouches.

rabbit.definition: An animal with long ears, strong back legs and a short tail.

goldfish.definition: A freshwater fish commonly kept in aquariums or ponds.
goldfish.exampleUsage: The goldfish swims in a maintained aquarium.

parrot.definition: A bird with a curved beak, often with brightly coloured feathers.
parrot.exampleUsage: The parrot sits on a perch.

turtle.definition: A reptile with a protective shell around its body.
turtle.exampleUsage: The turtle rests in its species-appropriate habitat.

guinea-pig.definition: A small domesticated rodent often kept as a companion animal.
guinea-pig.exampleUsage: The guinea pig stayed in a secure enclosure.

canary.definition: A small songbird, often yellow, sometimes kept as a pet.
canary.exampleUsage: The canary sings from its perch.

gerbil.definition: A small rodent with a long tail, sometimes kept as a pet.
gerbil.exampleUsage: The gerbil digs in the bedding.

golden-retriever.definition: A large friendly dog breed with a dense golden-colored coat, originally developed for retrieving game.
golden-retriever.exampleUsage: The Golden Retriever waited calmly beside its owner.

poodle.definition: A dog breed usually identified by a curly coat.
poodle.exampleUsage: The Poodle waits beside its owner.

bulldog.definition: A sturdy dog breed with a broad head and short coat.
bulldog.exampleUsage: The Bulldog rests beside its owner.

german-shepherd.definition: A large intelligent dog breed originally developed for herding and widely used in working roles.
german-shepherd.exampleUsage: The German Shepherd walked on a lead with its handler.

labrador.definition: A dog breed with a short dense coat.
labrador.exampleUsage: The Labrador walks with its owner.

beagle.definition: A small hound breed with a short coat and hanging ears.
beagle.exampleUsage: The Beagle stands beside its owner.

chihuahua.exampleUsage: The Chihuahua waits beside its owner.

dalmatian.definition: A dog breed usually with dark spots on a white coat.
dalmatian.exampleUsage: The Dalmatian walks with its owner.

husky.definition: A thick-coated dog breed associated with sled-dog work.
husky.exampleUsage: The Husky rests in a comfortable place.

pug.definition: A small dog breed with a short coat and curled tail.
pug.exampleUsage: The Pug rests beside its owner.

persian.definition: A cat breed usually with a long, thick coat.
persian.exampleUsage: The Persian cat rests in its carrier.

siamese.definition: A cat breed usually with a pale body and darker face, ears, legs and tail.
siamese.exampleUsage: The Siamese cat sits on a cushion.

maine-coon.definition: A large long-haired domestic cat breed known for a thick coat and tufted ears.
maine-coon.exampleUsage: The Maine Coon had a long fluffy tail.

tabby.definition: A cat with a striped, spotted or swirling coat pattern; tabby names a pattern rather than one breed.
tabby.exampleUsage: The tabby cat has clear stripes on its coat.

bengal.definition: A domestic cat breed with a spotted or marbled coat.
bengal.exampleUsage: The Bengal cat rests in its room.

ragdoll.definition: A large domestic cat breed known for blue eyes and a soft semi-long coat.
ragdoll.exampleUsage: The Ragdoll cat rested in its carrier.

british-shorthair.definition: A domestic cat breed with a dense short coat, broad face, and sturdy build.
british-shorthair.exampleUsage: The British Shorthair had a thick gray coat.

sphynx.definition: A domestic cat breed known for having very little visible hair and exposed skin.
sphynx.exampleUsage: The Sphynx cat wore a light blanket in the cool room.

abyssinian.definition: A short-haired domestic cat breed with bands of colour on individual hairs.
abyssinian.exampleUsage: The Abyssinian cat sits on a cushion.

scottish-fold.definition: A domestic cat breed known for ears that may fold forward because of a genetic cartilage trait.
scottish-fold.exampleUsage: The welfare note explains that Scottish Fold ear shape is linked to a cartilage mutation.

dog-food.exampleUsage: Hana buys dog food for her dog.

cat-food.exampleUsage: Hana buys cat food for her cat.

fish-food.definition: Food specially formulated for aquarium fish.
fish-food.exampleUsage: The fish food was labeled for the species in the tank.

bird-seed.definition: A mixture of seeds sold as food for suitable pet or wild birds.
bird-seed.exampleUsage: The bird seed bag listed its ingredients.

hay.definition: Dried grass used as food for suitable animals.
hay.exampleUsage: The shop stores hay in a dry place.

treats.definition: Small portions of food offered as rewards or occasional extras for an animal.
treats.exampleUsage: The owner checks which treats are suitable for the dog.

water-bowl.definition: A bowl used to provide drinking water for a pet.
water-bowl.exampleUsage: Fresh water was placed in the pet's water bowl.

food-bowl.definition: A bowl used to hold an animal’s food.
food-bowl.exampleUsage: The owner washes the food bowl after the meal.

feeding-bottle.definition: A bottle with a soft teat used to feed a young animal when appropriate.
feeding-bottle.exampleUsage: The feeding bottle is on the supply shelf.

chew-toy.definition: A pet toy designed to be safely chewed by an animal of the appropriate size and species.
chew-toy.exampleUsage: The owner chose a chew toy sized for the dog.

collar.definition: A band worn around an animal’s neck.
collar.exampleUsage: The dog has a plain collar.

leash.definition: A strap or cord attached to an animal to keep it close during a walk.
leash.exampleUsage: Omar keeps the dog on a leash.

harness.definition: Straps fitted around an animal’s body for attaching a lead.
harness.exampleUsage: The owner checks the fit of the dog’s harness.

pet-bed.definition: A cushion, mat, basket, or other sleeping place designed for a pet.
pet-bed.exampleUsage: The cat curled up in the pet bed.

cage.definition: An enclosure with bars or mesh used to contain an animal.
cage.exampleUsage: The bird cage has several perches.

aquarium.definition: A tank for keeping aquatic animals and plants.
aquarium.exampleUsage: The aquarium is on a stable stand.

litter-box.definition: A tray or box containing absorbent material where a cat can urinate and defecate indoors.
litter-box.exampleUsage: The litter box was kept in a quiet area.

cat-tree.definition: A tall indoor structure with platforms, scratching surfaces, or hiding spaces for cats.
cat-tree.exampleUsage: The cat climbed to the top of the cat tree.

pet-carrier.definition: A secure portable container designed to transport a pet safely.
pet-carrier.exampleUsage: The cat traveled to the clinic in a pet carrier.

name-tag.definition: A small label showing a pet’s name and sometimes contact details.
name-tag.exampleUsage: The owner checks the name tag on the collar.

pet-shampoo.definition: A shampoo formulated specifically for the skin and coat of certain animals.
pet-shampoo.exampleUsage: The label says the pet shampoo is intended for dogs.

brush.definition: A tool with bristles used to clean or smooth an animal’s coat.
brush.exampleUsage: The groomer puts the brush on the table.

nail-clipper.definition: A small tool designed to trim an animal’s claws.
nail-clipper.exampleUsage: The groomer puts the nail clipper beside the brush.

flea-treatment.definition: A veterinary product used to prevent or control fleas in animals; the correct product depends on species, weight, and professional or label guidance.
flea-treatment.exampleUsage: The veterinarian advised using only flea treatment approved for the pet's species.

pet-vitamins.definition: Vitamin supplements marketed for animals; they should be used only when appropriate for the pet's diet and veterinary needs.
pet-vitamins.exampleUsage: The veterinarian reviewed whether the pet needed any vitamin supplement.

pooper-scooper.definition: A tool used to pick up and dispose of pet feces without touching it directly.
pooper-scooper.exampleUsage: The owner used a pooper scooper in the yard.

training-pads.definition: Absorbent disposable or washable pads used during house-training for some pets.
training-pads.exampleUsage: Training pads were placed in the designated pet area.

pet-towel.definition: A towel kept specifically for drying or cleaning a pet.
pet-towel.exampleUsage: The dog was dried with a clean pet towel.

dental-chew.definition: A pet chew product designed to help mechanically clean teeth while an animal chews it; suitability varies by pet.
dental-chew.exampleUsage: The veterinarian suggested checking whether a dental chew is appropriate for the dog's size.

scratching-post.definition: A sturdy surface designed for cats to scratch with their claws.
scratching-post.exampleUsage: The cat used the scratching post instead of the sofa.

parakeet.definition: A small parrot, usually with a long tail.
parakeet.exampleUsage: The parakeet rests on a perch.

kitten.exampleUsage: The kitten stays close to its mother.

puppy.exampleUsage: The puppy rests beside its owner.

fish-flakes.definition: Thin dried pieces of prepared food formulated for certain aquarium fish.
fish-flakes.exampleUsage: The fish flakes floated briefly on the water.

birdseed.exampleUsage: The owner checks which birdseed mixture the care plan names.
birdseed.definition: Seeds sold as food for appropriate bird species.

bone.definition: A hard part of an animal’s skeleton; here, the word names a pet-shop item, not feeding advice.
bone.exampleUsage: The shop’s poster shows a drawing of a bone.

sweater.definition: A knitted garment, here designed to fit an animal’s body.
sweater.exampleUsage: The shop displays a small pet sweater.

bandana.definition: A square piece of cloth worn as a decorative neck scarf.
bandana.exampleUsage: A plain bandana is folded on the display shelf.

bell.definition: A small object that makes a ringing sound.
bell.exampleUsage: The small bell is on the display shelf.

bow.definition: A decorative knot with two loops, made from ribbon or cloth.
bow.exampleUsage: The groomer places a ribbon bow on the display.

raincoat.definition: A coat designed to keep rain off, here made for a pet.
raincoat.exampleUsage: The pet raincoat is on the display shelf.

booties.definition: Small coverings designed for an animal’s paws.
booties.exampleUsage: The owner asks whether the dog needs booties.

bird-cage.definition: An enclosure designed to house a pet bird safely, with appropriate space and furnishings.
bird-cage.exampleUsage: The bird cage had perches and space to move.

hamster-cage.definition: An enclosure designed to house a hamster with secure walls, bedding, and suitable space.
hamster-cage.exampleUsage: The hamster cage had deep bedding and a secure lid.

dog-bed.definition: A cushion, mat, or padded sleeping place designed for a dog.
dog-bed.exampleUsage: The dog rested on its bed.

terrarium.definition: An enclosed container for growing plants or housing suitable land animals.
terrarium.exampleUsage: The empty terrarium is on the shelf.

fish-bowl.definition: A rounded glass container associated with keeping fish; the term does not establish suitable housing for a species.
fish-bowl.exampleUsage: The empty fish bowl is on a shelf.

kennel.definition: A shelter or enclosure for a dog.
kennel.exampleUsage: The dog rests in its kennel.

rabbit-hutch.definition: A shelter or enclosure for rabbits, used as part of suitable housing.
rabbit-hutch.exampleUsage: The rabbit hutch opens onto an exercise area.

nesting-box.definition: An enclosed box or shelter provided for certain birds or small animals to nest in.
nesting-box.exampleUsage: The bird enclosure included a nesting box.

shampoo.definition: A liquid product for washing an animal’s coat, selected for the appropriate species.
shampoo.exampleUsage: The pet shampoo is intended for dogs.

flea-collar.definition: A pet collar containing a substance that controls fleas.
flea-collar.exampleUsage: The veterinarian warned that flea collars are species-specific products.

litter.definition: Absorbent material placed in a cat’s toilet tray.
litter.exampleUsage: The owner puts appropriate litter in the tray.

poop-bag.definition: A small disposable bag used to collect and contain pet feces during walks.
poop-bag.exampleUsage: The dog walker carried poop bags.

vaccination-card.definition: A record showing vaccinations an animal has received, including dates and other veterinary information.
vaccination-card.exampleUsage: The pet owner brought the vaccination card to the clinic.

microchip.definition: A tiny electronic identification device placed under an animal’s skin by a veterinary professional.
microchip.exampleUsage: The clinic scans the dog’s microchip to read its identification number.

display-window.definition: A shop window arranged to show products to passers-by.
display-window.exampleUsage: The display window shows pet supplies.

grooming-station.definition: An area equipped for washing, brushing, drying, or trimming pets.
grooming-station.exampleUsage: The grooming station has a raised wash area.

adoption-board.definition: A display showing information about animals available for adoption.
adoption-board.exampleUsage: The adoption board showed photos of pets needing homes.

cash-register.definition: A shop machine that records purchases and takes payments.
cash-register.exampleUsage: The cashier uses the cash register.

shelf.definition: A flat horizontal surface used to hold or display objects.
shelf.exampleUsage: The food bags stand on the shelf.

tank.definition: A container of water for aquatic animals.
tank.exampleUsage: The fish swims in the tank.

price-tag.definition: A label that shows a product’s price.
price-tag.exampleUsage: Maya checks the price tag before buying.

shopping-basket.definition: A portable basket used to carry purchases while shopping.
shopping-basket.exampleUsage: Maya puts a pet toy in her shopping basket.

toy-rack.definition: A shelf or stand used to display or organize toys.
toy-rack.exampleUsage: Pet toys were arranged on the toy rack.

fish.definition: An animal that lives in water, usually with fins and gills.
fish.exampleUsage: The fish swims in the tank.

toy.exampleUsage: The dog’s toy is beside its bed.

feed.exampleUsage: The owner asks how to feed the pet.

walk.definition: To take an animal out on foot for exercise.
walk.exampleUsage: Omar walks the dog after work.

groom.definition: To clean or care for an animal’s coat and appearance.
groom.exampleUsage: The owner asks who can groom the dog.

bathe.definition: To wash an animal’s body with water when appropriate for its species.
bathe.exampleUsage: The owner asks the groomer whether to bathe the dog.

train.definition: To teach an animal behaviours through repeated practice.
train.exampleUsage: Maya trains her dog to respond to its name.

play.definition: To take part in an enjoyable activity or game.
play.exampleUsage: Maya and her dog play with a suitable toy.

pet.exampleUsage: Maya asks about adopting a pet.

adopt.definition: To take an animal into your home and become responsible for its care.
adopt.exampleUsage: They plan to adopt a dog from a rescue centre.
